Since 0.1.1. The major version stays 0.

### Home
Games sit in one kind of collection and one Home grid (#264). Favorites is no longer built in. An older Favorites that holds games, hidden games, or a name you gave it stays as an ordinary collection. Y › Add to holds Home and each collection. Remove only takes a tile off the spot it is in. Hide is its own row. The Android Games and Apps shelves are gone. L1 Games and Apps open the board's Android folders.

A folder copy and a RomM copy with the same system and file name are one tile. Launch prefers the on-device copy. Saves still sync through RomM (#260).

Status icons update as soon as battery, network, or Bluetooth change (#286). A tap off an open L1 or R1 island closes it (#287).

The top screen's backdrop and wide art slide a little when the Thor moves, and drift back. Motion Off leaves them still (#262). A themed app keeps its object on the grid even when cover art was found (#263).

### Play
Eden loads a Switch game's update and DLC from RomM into the same folder as the game (#271).

Play time stops while the lid is closed (#261). One stretch whose end is already in the past counts at most twelve hours (#280). A stamp still in the future is not last played and does not add time past now (#269). A player crash ends the session when Home stays behind (#284).

### Libraries
A file whose size or hash does not match RomM does not say On device (#279). A multi-file ROM with no size and no hash stays unfinished and is not launched (#278). A finished file whose marker is missing still launches offline when the size and hash match (#268).

### Look
Afterglow draws the Thor's apps, common apps, and emulators as objects (#259). A pack font that fails to load wears Afterglow's face (#276). A scene that fails to load wears the inherited backdrop (#281). If Afterglow itself did not load, the first theme is used (#277).

### Fixes
Usage history is read off the thread that draws Home (#273). Launcher icons are rasterized off the thread that scrolls the grid (#283). The music slider's touch target is 48dp (#282).

A refused folder grant no longer crashes Home (#267). The folder picker keeps its purpose across recreation (#266). A launch from a screen that is gone is dropped (#275). A failed start of the other screen is tried again (#274). A cancelled download's save conflict is shown on a Home that is still up (#285). Left and right move between the two saves (#265). Decide later and Play activity show the calibrated back button (#272).

The release asset is `foldcade.apk`.

### Known issues
- Download progress is still an open gap. `ensureLocal` returns when the copy is ready and has no progress channel. https://github.com/predmore/foldcade/issues/11
- The Thor hardware checklist is open. A green emulator run is not a Thor pass. https://github.com/predmore/foldcade/issues/43
- GameNative's own library is not imported. Foldcade reads exported `.steam` files only. It does not read GameNative's private database. https://github.com/predmore/foldcade/issues/100
